items.text: Enter all scientific values explicitly. Sliders have display-only ranges; text entry retains off-tick and out-of-range values.
Omega uses three ordered real/imaginary pairs. No normalization is applied. update_index is separate from observer clocks.
eps, coupling g, phase_strength and the explicit k triple are the kernel parameters. k is not a spatial wave vector.
A historical preset or reference fill is an explicit action. Its source is shown; edits produce a user-supplied draft.
Recorded provenance known. Original design rationale unresolved where O02 applies.
PASSIVE OBSERVATION / DIAGNOSTIC. Selected observers and diagnostics do not feed back into Omega.
Structure/digest valid does not establish scientific replay or authenticate producer claims. Producer environment differs from the current viewer.
Resume preserves parameters and requires matching source/module identity. A changed configuration is a new run from a checkpoint, with named observers explicitly reinitialized.
Independent geometry — no dynamic attachment. Numeric wireframes display returned exact nodes and incidence. Exact expressions remain inspectable.
Research concepts and quarantined modules are excluded from executable controls. No Omega-to-shell mapping is established.
Application software: Apache-2.0. Qt/PySide6/Shiboken use the LGPLv3 route and remain separately installed and replaceable. Third-party components retain their own notices.

provenance.notes: Saved gate/torus seed; original selection rationale is OPEN_NONBLOCKING (O02).
